earlier_scan.note: Spurious language: retired from ISO 639-3 in 2019 as non-existent; no references.

sources.citation: Hammarström, Forkel, Haspelmath & Bank. Glottolog 5.x, languoid mina1267 'Mina (India)' (Bookkeeping; ISO retirement 2018-011, reason non-existent, effective 2019-01-25).
sources.note: Nothing; classification = Bookkeeping, zero descriptive references; only reference is the ISO change request.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2018. Request for Change to ISO 639-3 Language Code, Change Request Number 2018-011 (retire [myi] Mina; adopted, effective 2019-01-25). Dallas: SIL International. 5 pp.
sources.note: Nothing; the document retires the code because 'There is no evidence that the language exists' — p.2: 'The name Mina designates a caste name and a tribe name in India... Harold Hammarstrom declares simply that "Mina (India) [myi] is a caste whose members speak Dhundari [dhd] (Samantha 1998)"'.

sources.citation: Samantha, D. K. 1998. Mina Chowkidar. In K. S. Singh (ed.), Rajasthan (People of India 38), 647-650. Mumbai: Popular Prakashan.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: The ethnographic source Hammarström cites for 'Mina is a caste whose members speak Dhundari'; would only confirm the identity ruling (which language Mina people speak), not supply a stress statement. Low value for the stress catalog.
